subject: Quickstart intake - demo coordination for Buildly
messages:
From: Samir Khatri <samir@buildly.com>
To: docs@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart: Buildly - trial + one-off technical demo?

Hi Redwood team,

I just completed the developer quickstart and routed through the docs CTA. We're evaluating Redwood for inference in our staging environment (small bursty workloads, mostly token-level scoring). I’m Samir (platform engineer at Buildly). A couple of quick details:

- We'd like a short technical walkthrough focused on deployment patterns and cost controls (KV cache, batching recommendations).
- Our test app is in the us-west region; timezone is PDT.
- Prefer a 30–45 minute session next week if possible.

Link to quick repro: https://github.com/buildly/repro (private)

Can someone from the docs/engineering side connect me with an engineer for a short demo? Happy to share a brief example of our logs if helpful.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khatri
Platform Engineer, Buildly
samir@buildly.com

---
Note: Submitted via docs CTA (developer intent)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@buildly.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart intake — demo coordination for Buildly

Hi Samir — thanks for filing this via the quickstart CTA and for the repro link. I'm Naomi on the onboarding SDR team; I’ll coordinate a short technical demo with engineering.

Quick plan:
- Camila (cc’d) will lead a 30-min technical walkthrough and cover batching/KV caching best practices.
- I can arrange a calendar slot and share a short mutual action checklist ahead of the call.

Could you confirm:
1) Preferred session length: 30 or 45 minutes?
2) Two windows that work for you next week (PDT): e.g., Tue 7/22 10:00–11:00 or Wed 7/23 14:00–15:00 — we’ll consolidate to a single slot.

I attached a quick mutual action plan to get us prepped (MAP-Buildly-Initial.pdf). If you can also attach a 1-page outline of the key use case, Camila can tailor the demo.

Scheduling link (if easier): https://redwood.ai/scheduling/naomi

Best,
Naomi Feldman
SDR, Developer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP-Buildly-Initial.pdf (1 page stub: mutual action checklist)
From: Samir Khatri <samir@buildly.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart intake — demo coordination for Buildly

Thanks Naomi — 30 minutes is perfect.

Availability (PDT):
- Tue 7/22: 10:00–10:45 (good)
- Wed 7/23: 14:00–14:45 (also OK)

We’d like the session to focus on: cost/latency tradeoffs for short-lived scoring jobs, and whether prefix caching would help for our pattern. I attached a small sample of logs that show request size/latency distributions.

Two quick notes: we’re fine with either internal videoconf or a recorded session. Also, do we need an NDA?

Cheers,
Samir

Attachments: sample_logs.txt (small text export)

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart intake — demo coordination for Buildly

Hi Samir — thanks for the notes and the logs. I’ll run the demo and keep it tightly scoped to your ask. Proposed agenda (30 minutes):

- 0–5m: intros + objectives
- 5–20m: walkthrough of recommended serving patterns for bursty scoring (batching, prefix/KV cache, quantization recommendations)
- 20–30m: runway/next steps (POC plan + data required)

If that works I’ll lock a single slot. Based on availability you sent, I’m proposing:

- Final slot: Thu 7/17 14:00–14:30 PDT (I know that’s sooner than the windows listed — we can also pick Tue 7/22 10:00 if preferred).

I attached a short demo agenda file and an .ics invite (invite.ics). Naomi — can you send the calendar invite and include a short list of items we want Samir to share beforehand (e.g., small sample payload, expected RPS, any compliance constraints)?

Camila Reyes
Senior ML Engineer, Inference Team
camila@redwood.ai

Attachments: demo-agenda.md, invite.ics
